workflows.purpose: Decide, at gguf load time, which quantized routes and memory-adaptive adapters a model is admitted to.
workflows.retention_criterion: while models are loaded through tinygrad/llm/model.py

workflows.purpose: Select and emit the decode GEMV and flash-decode attention kernels for an admitted model.
Select between direct-packed, packed-WMMA, and graph-GEMM prefill routes and execute the chosen one.
Turn a Q4_K/Q6_K block layout into a lowered kernel body with the correct lane and tile mapping.
Render AMD native ISA for the research renderer, including cooperative LDS staging and MMQ record producers.
workflows.retention_criterion: until DEV=AMD:ISA is promoted to a supported path or the native-ISA experiment is retired
